verdict_a_acceptance.basis: The standalone member/warm failure-and-retry case is still not imported by the native runner and has no native execution or row-absence receipt. Its provisional receipt explicitly leaves original_absence_verified false. Inventory member/reload and admin warm/reload branches are outside this module.

prior_findings.request_scope: addressed: origin, exact route, POST, users Content-Profile, journal-verified user_id and organization_id, and synthetic preferred_name all match before the first request is failed. Later matching requests and foreign requests are continued; extra target attempts fail the case.
prior_findings.disable_failure: addressed: stop switches to pass-through before disabling and retains the requestPaused listener when Fetch.disable rejects, so later paused requests still receive continueRequest. A later stop may retry disabling; the case reports failure.
prior_findings.restoration_receipt: addressed: the case distinguishes local draft discard, owned-row value restoration, and original row absence. Success stays provisional until the outer runner's conditional deletion and absence check.

residual_risks: No automated guard exercises the CDP interceptor against real request metadata, disable rejection, or foreign profile traffic; source inspection alone cannot prove those runtime paths.
On an ambiguous write or repeated disable failure, cleanup depends on the runner's durable journal and live CDP session; native restoration is unverified.

checks.runner_reference_search: no import or call found outside the standalone case
